about_the_game:
🏁 Street Drive Rush

Master the streets in a high-speed, urban driving experience packed with challenge and variety.
In Street Drive Rush, you’ll take on the city in three distinct driving modes: Time Trial, Parkour, and Drift. Choose your path, push your limits, and prove your skills behind the wheel.

🚗 Game Features

  • Three Unique Modes

    • Time Trial – Race against the clock and beat checkpoint challenges.

    • Parkour – Navigate wild stunt courses where your car must jump, land, and climb across urban obstacles.

    • Drift – Rack up points by mastering corners and controlling your slide.

  • Speed Capture System
    Speed zones across the city measure your velocity — go too fast, get caught, and earn bragging rights.

  • Collect Diamonds
    Hunt for hidden diamonds scattered across each map to unlock rewards and perfect your routes.

  • Mission-Based Gameplay
    Each mode features carefully crafted missions that increase in difficulty and demand true driving precision.

  • Stylized Urban Environment
    A sleek, colorful city filled with highways, rooftops, ramps, and tight turns — all optimized for smooth performance.

🎮 Perfect For Fans Of:

  • Drift and stunt-based driving games

  • Arcade-style racing with bite-sized missions

  • Challenge runs and high-score chasing

  • Fast-paced, casual driving fun with replay value

Are you ready to own the streets?

name: Street Drive Rush

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550 (2GB VRAM minimum)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Dedicated graphics card required for smooth performance, otherwise play on low graphics settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Dedicated graphics card required for smooth performance, otherwise play on low graphics settings

short_description: Race through a stylized city in Time Trial, Parkour, and Drift modes. Master checkpoints, pull off stunts, collect diamonds, and trigger Speed Capture zones to earn big in this fast-paced urban driving challenge.
